# ANALYSIS: WALK_FORWARD_OOS_TEST_20260201_20260618

**Filed:** 2026-07-21
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** analysis
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

We want to validate the current engine's performance on the J anchor days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04) in an out-of-sample setting using a walk-forward approach (3-month train, 1-month test) from 2026-02-01 to 2026-06-18. Additionally, we want to check that the real-fills simulation matches the BS-sim within ±20% for these anchor days.

## Mechanism

We will run a walk-forward backtest: for each month in the test period (2026-02-01 to 2026-06-18), we train on the prior 3 months and test on the current month. We will aggregate the P&L and compute edge capture on the J anchor days that fall in the test windows. We will also run a real-fills simulation (using real OPRA data) on the three anchor days and compare to BS-sim.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** We assume the engine is running with the current params.json (Safe account) which uses a $2K account baseline for position sizing (3 contracts at $1K-$2K). For the OOS test, we simulate the engine's behavior as if it were trading with the same risk rules.
2. **Sample bias:** The walk-forward period is 2026-02-01 to 2026-06-18 (5 months). The training windows are rolling 3 months, so the first test month is 2026-05 (trained on Feb-Apr). This is a small sample (5 test months) and may not be representative of all regimes. Overfit risk is mitigated by the walk-forward design but the test period is limited.
3. **Out-of-sample:** The walk-forward test is by design OOS (each test month is not used in training). We will report the OOS result after the test.
4. **Real-fills:** We will validate real-fills on the top 3 J days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04) by comparing BS-sim to real OPRA fills. We require the difference to be within ±20%. This check has not been done yet.
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day: we will look for the largest single-day loss in the OOS period. Max drawdown: we will compute the maximum peak-to-trough during the OOS period. Blow-up scenario: a sequence of losses that exceeds the daily loss limit.
6. **Concentration:** We will compute the percentage of total OOS P&L coming from the top 5 days.
